## SOP Global Policies

- single_user_per_conversation: Authenticate exactly one user at the start. Deny requests involving a different user.
- one_tool_per_turn: Never combine a tool call with a user-facing response in the same turn.
- confirmation_before_mutations: Before any DB-updating action (cancel, refund), list full details and wait for explicit 'yes'. Append the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
- no_fabrication: Only use data provided by user or returned by tools.
- actionable_ride_statuses: May only cancel 'scheduled' rides and refund 'completed' rides. Active rides in progress cannot be cancelled or refunded via automated agent.
- safety_escalation: Any mention of physical harm, accidents, or severe driver misconduct MUST be routed to the Safety team via human transfer after collecting initial details. Do NOT attempt to resolve safety issues.
- refund_limits: Maximum refund amount without supervisor approval is $50. Full fare refunds only permitted if ride was entirely unfulfilled.
- time_zones: All times in DB are local to the ride's starting location.
- transfer_policy: If out of scope, inform user and ASK before transferring.

## SOP Node Policies
```yaml
START:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Acknowledge user contact and proceed to authentication.
AUTH:
  tool_hints: find_user_by_phone, find_user_by_email
  policy: |
    Authenticate via phone number OR email address. MUST use one of the listed tools. If fails, ask retry or end.
AUTH_FAIL:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that authentication failed. Offer a retry or terminate the conversation.
ROUTE:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Identify intent: info/cancel/refund/safety/out-of-scope. Safety issues map to 'safety', not immediate transfer.
INFO:
  tool_hints: get_ride_details, get_user_profile, get_receipt
  policy: |
    Look up user profile, past/upcoming rides, or receipt details. No mutations.
CANCEL_CHECK:
  tool_hints: get_ride_details
  policy: |
    Verify status = scheduled. If not, route to DENIED_CANCEL.
CANCEL_RIDE:
  tool_hints: cancel_scheduled_ride
  policy: |
    Collect ride ID. Confirm before tool call. Note that cancellation fees may apply if within 5 minutes of pickup. After: status -> cancelled.
DENIED_CANCEL:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that only 'scheduled' rides can be cancelled.
REFUND_CHECK:
  tool_hints: get_ride_details
  policy: |
    Verify status = completed. If not, route to DENIED_REFUND.
REFUND_RIDE:
  tool_hints: process_ride_refund
  policy: |
    Collect ride ID + reason for refund (e.g., bad route, late driver). Confirm before tool call. Maximum refund is $50. After: status -> refunded.
DENIED_REFUND:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that only 'completed' rides are eligible for automated refunds.
SAFETY_REPORT:
  tool_hints: log_safety_incident
  policy: |
    Collect a brief summary of the safety incident, driver name, and ride ID. Do NOT promise a specific outcome. Log the incident, then route to TRANSFER.
TRANSFER:
  tool_hints: transfer_to_human_agents
  policy: |
    Call transfer_to_human_agents, then send exactly: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'
END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Ask if anything else; if not, end conversation.
TRANSFER_END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Terminal node after transferring to a human agent. No further action.
```

## SOP Flowchart
```mermaid
flowchart TD
START([User contacts Agent]) --> AUTH[Authenticate user via phone or email]
AUTH -->|failed| AUTH_FAIL([Inform user — retry or end])
AUTH -->|authenticated| ROUTE{Identify user intent}
ROUTE -->|info request| INFO[Look up ride / driver / receipt info]
ROUTE -->|cancel ride| CANCEL_CHECK{Ride status = scheduled?}
ROUTE -->|refund request| REFUND_CHECK{Ride status = completed?}
ROUTE -->|safety issue| SAFETY_REPORT[Collect details + log incident]
ROUTE -->|out of scope| TRANSFER[Transfer to human agent]
INFO --> END([Ask if anything else])
CANCEL_CHECK -->|yes| CANCEL_RIDE[Collect ride ID + confirm + cancel]
CANCEL_CHECK -->|no| DENIED_CANCEL([Inform user: not cancellable])
CANCEL_RIDE --> END
DENIED_CANCEL --> END
REFUND_CHECK -->|yes| REFUND_RIDE[Collect ride ID + reason + confirm + refund]
REFUND_CHECK -->|no| DENIED_REFUND([Inform user: not refundable])
REFUND_RIDE --> END
DENIED_REFUND --> END
SAFETY_REPORT --> TRANSFER
TRANSFER --> TRANSFER_END([Human agent handoff complete])
```

  tool_hints: verify_account_pin
  policy: |
    Authenticate user via account number and PIN. MUST use the verify_account_pin tool. If it fails, ask the user to retry or end the conversation.
AUTH_FAIL:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that authentication failed. Offer a retry or end the conversation.
ROUTE:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Identify intent: balance inquiry / transfer funds / report lost card / out of scope. General account questions map to 'balance inquiry'.
INFO:
  tool_hints: get_account_balance, get_recent_transactions
  policy: |
    Retrieve account balances and recent transactions. Do not make any modifications to the account.
TRANSFER_CHECK:
  tool_hints: check_account_balance, validate_routing_number
  policy: |
    Verify that the account has sufficient funds for the requested transfer amount and that the destination routing number is valid.
TRANSFER_FUNDS:
  tool_hints: execute_funds_transfer
  policy: |
    Collect destination account number, routing number, and amount. Confirm all details with the user before calling the tool. After success, provide the confirmation number.
TRANSFER_DENIED:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that the transfer cannot be completed due to invalid details or insufficient funds.
LOST_CARD_CHECK:
  tool_hints: get_card_status
  policy: |
    Check if the user's debit or credit card is currently active. If it is already frozen or cancelled, route to inactive.
FREEZE_CARD:
  tool_hints: freeze_bank_card
  policy: |
    Collect the last 4 digits of the card to freeze. Confirm with the user before calling the tool to freeze the card. Inform the user a new card will be mailed within 5-7 business days.
CARD_ALREADY_FROZEN:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that the card is already inactive and no further action is required.
ESCALATE:
  tool_hints: transfer_to_human_agents
  policy: |
    Call transfer_to_human_agents, then send exactly: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'
ESCALATE_END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Terminate agent interaction as the human agent takes over.
END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Ask if the user needs help with anything else; if not, end the conversation.
```

## SOP Flowchart
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    START([User contacts Agent]) --> AUTH[Authenticate user via account number and PIN]
    AUTH -->|failed| AUTH_FAIL([Inform user — retry or end])
    AUTH -->|authenticated| ROUTE{Identify user intent}

    ROUTE -->|balance inquiry| INFO[Retrieve account balance and recent transactions]
    ROUTE -->|transfer funds| TRANSFER_CHECK{Check sufficient funds and valid destination}
    ROUTE -->|report lost card| LOST_CARD_CHECK{Check if card is active}
    ROUTE -->|out of scope| ESCALATE[Transfer to human agent]

    INFO --> END([Ask if anything else])

    TRANSFER_CHECK -->|valid| TRANSFER_FUNDS[Collect transfer details — confirm — execute]
    TRANSFER_CHECK -->|invalid or insufficient funds| TRANSFER_DENIED([Inform user: transfer cannot be completed])
    TRANSFER_FUNDS --> END
    TRANSFER_DENIED --> END

    LOST_CARD_CHECK -->|active| FREEZE_CARD[Confirm and freeze the card]
    LOST_CARD_CHECK -->|inactive| CARD_ALREADY_FROZEN([Inform user card is already inactive])
    FREEZE_CARD --> END
    CARD_ALREADY_FROZEN --> END

    ESCALATE --> ESCALATE_END([Human agent handoff complete])

```

- policy_vs_scope: Policy-limited requests (e.g., trying to cancel an approved application) stay in flow; do not transfer.

- single_user_per_conversation: Authenticate exactly one user at the start. Deny requests involving a different user.
- one_tool_per_turn: Never combine a tool call with a user-facing response in the same turn.
- confirmation_before_mutations: Before any DB-updating action, list full details and wait for explicit 'yes'. Append the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
- no_fabrication: Only use data provided by user or returned by tools.
- single_mutation_per_claim: Each claim can undergo only ONE update per session.
- actionable_claim_statuses: May only update claims with status 'open' or 'pending_info'.
- transfer_policy: If out of scope, inform user and ASK before transferring.
- post_action_info: Provide post-action details (claim number, expected review time) only AFTER tool execution.

## SOP Node Policies
```yaml
START:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Greet the user and prompt for authentication.
AUTH:
  tool_hints: authenticate_policy_holder
  policy: |
    Authenticate via policy number and zip code. MUST use the listed tool. If fails, ask retry or end.
AUTH_FAIL:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that authentication failed. Offer a retry or end the conversation.
ROUTE:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Identify intent: check status, file new claim, update claim, or out-of-scope.
STATUS_CHECK:
  tool_hints: get_claim_details
  policy: |
    Look up current claim status, deductibles, and payouts. No mutations allowed.
FILE_CLAIM_CHECK:
  tool_hints: get_policy_details
  policy: |
    Verify policy status is 'active'. If not active, route to denied.
FILE_CLAIM:
  tool_hints: file_new_claim
  policy: |
    Collect incident date, type, and description. Confirm before tool call. After: status -> 'open'.
DENIED_INACTIVE:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user their policy is not active and they cannot file a claim.
UPDATE_CLAIM_CHECK:
  tool_hints: get_claim_details
  policy: |
    Verify claim status is 'open' or 'pending_info'. If 'closed' or 'denied', route to denied.
UPDATE_CLAIM:
  tool_hints: update_existing_claim
  policy: |
    Collect new evidence, police report numbers, or repair estimates. Confirm before tool call. After: status -> 'pending_info'.
DENIED_CLOSED:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user the claim is closed or denied and cannot be modified.
TRANSFER:
  tool_hints: transfer_to_human_agents
  policy: |
    Call transfer_to_human_agents, then send exactly: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'
TRANSFER_END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Terminal node for human handoff.
END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Ask if anything else; if not, end conversation.
```

## SOP Flowchart
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    START([User contacts Agent]) --> AUTH[Authenticate user via policy number and zip code]

    AUTH -->|failed| AUTH_FAIL([Inform user — retry or end])
    AUTH -->|authenticated| ROUTE{Identify user intent}

    ROUTE -->|check status| STATUS_CHECK[Look up claim status and details]
    ROUTE -->|file new claim| FILE_CLAIM_CHECK{Policy status = active?}
    ROUTE -->|update claim| UPDATE_CLAIM_CHECK{Claim status = open?}
    ROUTE -->|out of scope| TRANSFER[Transfer to human agent]

    STATUS_CHECK --> END([Ask if anything else])

    FILE_CLAIM_CHECK -->|yes| FILE_CLAIM[Collect incident details — confirm — file claim]
    FILE_CLAIM_CHECK -->|no| DENIED_INACTIVE([Inform user: policy inactive])
    FILE_CLAIM --> END

    UPDATE_CLAIM_CHECK -->|yes| UPDATE_CLAIM[Collect new documents/details — confirm — update]
    UPDATE_CLAIM_CHECK -->|no| DENIED_CLOSED([Inform user: claim closed])
    UPDATE_CLAIM --> END

    DENIED_INACTIVE --> END
    DENIED_CLOSED --> END

    TRANSFER --> TRANSFER_END([Human agent handoff complete])

```

  tool_hints: null

  tool_hints: get_account_balance, get_recent_transactions
  policy: |
    Retrieve account balances and recent transactions. Do not make any modifications to the account.
TRANSFER_CHECK:
  tool_hints: check_account_balance, validate_routing_number
  policy: |
    Verify that the account has sufficient funds for the requested transfer amount and that the destination routing number is valid.
TRANSFER_FUNDS:
  tool_hints: execute_funds_transfer
  policy: |
    Collect destination account number, routing number, and amount. Confirm all details with the user before calling the tool. After success, provide the confirmation number.
TRANSFER_DENIED:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that the transfer cannot be completed due to invalid details or insufficient funds.
LOST_CARD_CHECK:
  tool_hints: get_card_status
  policy: |
    Check if the user's debit or credit card is currently active. If it is already frozen or cancelled, route to inactive.
FREEZE_CARD:
  tool_hints: freeze_bank_card
  policy: |
    Collect the last 4 digits of the card to freeze. Confirm with the user before calling the tool to freeze the card. Inform the user a new card will be mailed within 5-7 business days.
CARD_ALREADY_FROZEN:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Inform the user that the card is already inactive and no further action is required.
ESCALATE:
  tool_hints: transfer_to_human_agents
  policy: |
    Call transfer_to_human_agents, then send exactly: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'
ESCALATE_END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Terminate agent interaction as the human agent takes over.
END:
  tool_hints: null
  policy: |
    Ask if the user needs help with anything else; if not, end the conversation.
